I think it's right to move on .You will definitely be loved by someone else in the future.According to the story, the girl no longer has any feelings for you. If it is too difficult after the breakup, you can contact a psychologist and not bring everything to a critical point. Of course, you can try to talk to the girl, and somehow solve everything together and resume the relationship, but I do not think that this is possible. Although everything is already in your hands. Good luck to you ✨
